results.title: The same path with and without `?fields=`
results.evidence: `?fields=` discards the rows of 12 of 12 listings sampled, and keeps none: ['/api/v1/models', '/api/v1/features', '/api/v1/featuresets', '/api/v1/warrants', '/api/v1/principals', '/api/v1/roles'] …. `project()` narrows `payload['rows']` or a bare list; exactly ONE route in the API answers `rows` (`conventions.page` has a single caller), so every other listing falls through to `_narrow` on the top-
